title: Fix three runtime bugs in Manage Ticket Queue (support360_manage_ticket_queue) b
description:
I tested the latest deployment and found these remaining runtime issues:

Assign Ticket: Clicking Assign results in "Select an agent to assign the ticket to." Fix the Assign UI/action so an agent can be selected and the selected agent is correctly passed to the business logic. Verify that the ticket is assigned successfully.
Start Progress / Workflow: Manage Ticket Queue throws AttributeError: module 'datetime' has no attribute 'now'. Fix the Python datetime implementation in the relevant business logic, redeploy it, and verify that Start Progress and other workflow actions execute successfully.
Direct Editing: The system says ticket fields cannot be edited directly from Manage Ticket Queue. Keep this restriction if it is part of the intended design. Instead, ensure Assign, Reassign, Start Progress, Add Comment, Add Attachment, and Resolve all work correctly through their respective actions.

Do not just suppress or hide these errors. Fix the underlying UI/business-logic implementation, deploy the changes, and test them in the runtime. Then perform regression testing for: Create Ticket → Assign → Reassign → Start Progress → Add Comment → Resolve → Activity Log.
